title: The Words — Sc062: Darwin's taunt-dance for a hallway audience (59 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: How to stage a one-kid performance with a built-in audience: the performer (Darwin) gets the only fully animated puppet (196 kf plus 644+360 kf of head comps), placed centre on his own layer, while four classmates are parked on named layers around him as near-static reactors - Tobias's pointing-laugh comp (350 kf master symbol) does most of the audience's acting, Carmen, Ocho and Carrie hold poses. The comedy is in the performer's escalation (smug -> furious grimace-stomp -> bow -> splits), not in moving the crowd. One background, no cuts, 59 frames.
notes: Darwin performs centre-frame while four classmates watch from fixed positions, each on their own named scene layer: carmen (left), ocho (upper left), tobias (right), carrie (upper right, floating). Tobias points and laughs for most of the shot; the others barely move.

Darwin's routine escalates across the sheet: mock-horror point (f1), smug lean (f8), finger-up lecture (f15), furious grimace-stomp (f23-30), full bow showing his back (f37), delighted hop (f45), and a splits finale with a shocked face (f52-59).

Masami's puppet symbols are in the file and counted in the cast by the builder, but she does not appear in any of the 9 sampled contact-sheet frames - her parts may be nested inside Tobias's comp (which nests 3 puppets) or fall between samples. Flagged as an honest gap in NOTES.md.
